title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
summary: GPT-5.3-Codex is a Codex-native agent that pairs frontier coding performance with general reasoning to support long-horizon, real-world technical work.
body: GPT-5.3-Codex is a Codex-native agent that pairs frontier coding performance with general reasoning to support long-horizon, real-world technical work.
summaryZh: GPT-5.3-Codex是OpenAI推出的一款Codex原生Agent模型，它将前沿的编程能力与通用推理水平进行了深度融合。该模型专为支持长周期、复杂的真实世界技术开发任务而设计，标志着代码编写与智能体辅助开发技术达到了新的高度。
